sentences.text: Edith Marsh (S2) stated she uses a walking frame and does not go upstairs.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated her son Gary lives with her, works at the garage on Station Road, and helps her with shopping, getting up, and tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary works from eight till six, sometimes later.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she uses a commode and is not always quick enough to the toilet, wearing pads.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary changes her if the pad is wet when he is home, or she manages herself.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she is alone all day while Gary is at work, but has the telly.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary leaves her a sandwich for lunch, usually.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated there was no food in the fridge on Saturday, only a bit of milk that was gone off, and she brought Edith Marsh (S2) a dinner round.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated the fridge has been empty three or four times in the last few weeks when she looked.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she has been living at the address since 1962 and does not want to move home.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she would accept carers coming in if Gary does not mind, to avoid relying on him all day.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she pops in most afternoons and observed Edith Marsh (S2) left in wet clothes most days, specifically noting the pad and skirt were wet when she arrived at
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she estimates the wet clothes situation happens four or five days a week.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she helps Edith Marsh (S2) change if she will let her.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated Edith Marsh (S2) has not had her tablets for a week, noting the box was full since last Tuesday.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she forgets her tablets and Gary has been busy.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary has never hit or hurt her, describing him as a good boy who is just tired.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she has never seen anything like hitting or hurting, and that Gary is not unkind to her, just not there.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she is raising a safeguarding concern regarding Edith Marsh (S2) being left wet, without food, and without tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she is okay with raising a safeguarding concern if it helps Gary.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she gets her pension paid into her own account and has her card.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she does not get Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she asked Gary once if Edith Marsh (S2) gets Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) provided her phone number as oh one four six.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will ring Dr Patel (GP) about the missed tablets and ask the chemist about a blister pack and a check.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will arrange an emergency home care package with two calls a day (morning and lunchtime) for washing, changing, and a meal, starting by Friday the 27
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will phone Gary tonight and book his carer's assessment for next week.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she is willing to keep popping in.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will return on Wednesday the 2nd of December with the Attendance Allowance form.
